left.title: Trump retreats from public view as government shutdown continues over border wall fight
left.body: The president has relied on his Twitter account to blame Democrats for the closure and cast illegal immigration as a threat to the country.
left.roundup: The government shutdown continues into its second week as President Trump threatens to close the southern border if Congress does not approve funding for a wall.

center.title: Government shutdown: White House aide predicts long standoff as Trump talks border closure
center.body: The partial federal government shutdown entered its second week Saturday with no apparent movement toward a resolution.
center.roundup: The government shutdown continues into its second week as President Trump threatens to close the southern border if Congress does not approve funding for a wall.

right.title: Shutdown Day 7: Trump threatens to close border without wall funding
right.body: President Trump on Friday threatened to close the southern border if Democrats do not relent in the standoff over border wall funding, which has resulted in a partial government shutdown that has lasted a week.
right.roundup: The government shutdown continues into its second week as President Trump threatens to close the southern border if Congress does not approve funding for a wall.
